deriveSizeOverride.reason: fixture-scale mechanism proof; full 4096 needs Blender/human-run per chain ao_bake note

falsifier.detail: run1 vs run2: all 12 stage outputs identical; no differing stage

guard.env: model credentials stripped from subprocess env (openai/anthropic/xai/grok/imagine/replicate/hugging/together/cohere/gemini/bedrock)
guard.refusal: throws on manifest kind imagine/llm/model or script containing imagine; throws on stage with no parameters

ao.method: flat 230 grey at derive size, staged by station (Blender bake is human-run per chain ao_bake note)

glb.method: deterministic synthetic trimesh fixture (plane + nose-like relief bump + eye/brow blobs, same geometry rule as hand-steps test); full-scale Aisha GLB untracked (manifest glb sha is placeholder)
glb.subjectGlbPin: fixture copy of chain-manifest.json sets subjects.aisha.glb_sha256 to PLACEHOLDER_GLB_SHA256 (the manifest pins the real Aisha GLB 2be4b098 since f5c46bfa2; the synthetic fixture GLB is not it)

rederived.method: two fixture-scale runs of runReplayChain on the new manifest (size 512, placeholder GLB pin), run1 == run2 on every stage output
rederived.why: station fixture gained the nose-like relief bump shared with the hand-steps fixture so the derive density gate (400000 faces/m2) admits it; the flat plane measured 0 faces/m2 and refused

scope: executes the 7 chain-manifest hand steps via the tracked replay driver (each stage a subprocess); compose/colour-replay keep their tracked reports (compose-report.json, solve-report.json); no new stage, no model call, no shipped GLB
